qualification: Shared responsive UI and upload persistence

fixes.trigger: Shrink an open 1440x900 desktop window to 1024x500
fixes.before: Explicit height remains 852px and clips the dialog
fixes.change: Refit explicit frame on resize without overwriting preferred saved size

fixes.trigger: Delete a meeting with a long unbroken title
fixes.before: Heading intrinsic width pushes close button outside viewport
fixes.change: Allow heading to wrap and preserve close button width

fixes.trigger: Browser/table scroll finishes just after opening menu
fixes.before: Menu disappears before an action can be selected
fixes.change: Keep sheets open and re-anchor visible desktop triggers

fixes.trigger: Save a record with a long unbroken title at 320px
fixes.change: Constrain stack to viewport and wrap message/title

fixes.trigger: Escape inside an unsaved meeting calendar
fixes.before: Calendar and parent meeting drawer both close
fixes.change: Use shared focus ownership, accessible dialog/controls and restore trigger

fixes.trigger: Browser scroll finishes after opening anchored calendar
fixes.change: Re-anchor visible triggers and preserve mobile sheets

limitations: Browser local upload tests use a fresh /app workspace and IndexedDB, not the hosted backend
Actual live shared/vault suite uses native isolated Convex43230 + actual Better Auth43487 and root app43477; no mocked query transport or demo runtime
Chromium viewport and touch emulation; physical devices and native Electron shell are not covered by these suites
Screenshots and success measurements do not constitute production performance benchmarks
